items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Here's some names you'll remember. Frankie Masters? No.

ctx.x: So the people applauded, and just about when they stopped applauding, they started applauding again. So Lou Forbes comes out, and he's taking a bow, and he's telling you guys, come on outside and take a bow. We stand about a footwork, taking a bow. But they don't know that they're not clapping for us, they're clapping for Roosevelt's picture, the American flag, that's in back of us. This is a funny story. This is from 1933. Here's some names you'll remember. Frankie Masters? No. Now this was at the Sanger Theatre.
And you worked with who at the Sanger? I worked with Forbes. Forbes?
